identity.name: Comet Ping Pong
identity.notes: The official site and linked Toast store bind the same sole Comet Ping Pong business at 5037 Connecticut Avenue NW in Washington's Chevy Chase neighborhood.

sources.excerpt: The official single-location site identifies Comet Ping Pong at 5037 Connecticut Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20008, with phone (202) 364-0404 and links its menu and exact Toast store.

The complete current menu publishes dinner starters, salads, customizable and favorite pizzas, pastas, desserts, weekend brunch pizzas, and nonalcoholic soft drinks. Alcohol-only cocktail and wine sections were excluded.
The restaurant-linked store binds to 5037 Connecticut Avenue NW and exposes current featured/favorite pizzas, starters, salads, pastas, online beverages, and desserts; Beer is out of POC scope.

Toast item dialogs expose gluten-free crust/soy-cheese substitutions, allergy request modifiers, and a best-efforts request advisory. These controls do not form a product-by-allergen matrix and do not establish cross-contact or allergen absence.

Fresh official-site, document, linked-vendor, and targeted searches found current menus and generic request controls but no restaurant-issued allergen matrix, nutrition document, or cross-contact disclosure.

attempts.query: Inspect the official homepage and full menu navigation for identity, complete food/nonalcoholic sections, allergy guidance, gluten-free notes, and ordering links.
attempts.outcome: The exact Chevy Chase DC menu and location were confirmed. The site publishes item descriptions and optional gluten-free crust, but no product-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.

attempts.query: Search cometpingpong.com indexed/downloadable PDF, image, nutrition, ingredient, FAQ, allergen, and sitemap/document surfaces.
attempts.outcome: No restaurant-issued allergen, nutrition, ingredient, or cross-contact document was found.

attempts.query: Inspect the exact official-linked Toast food/drink/dessert categories and item-detail allergy/substitution controls.
attempts.outcome: Toast exposes descriptions, substitution choices, generic allergy request flags, and a best-efforts advisory, but no product matrix or specific cross-contact disclosure.

attempts.query: Comet Ping Pong allergen allergy nutrition ingredients menu PDF; site:cometpingpong.com and exact Toast-store variants.
attempts.outcome: Targeted search reconfirmed the official menu and vendor controls but found no official allergen matrix.

matrixSearch.notes: Official allergen information is accurately unavailable after all four required searches. Direct positives are limited to literal restaurant-issued or restaurant-linked ingredients; gluten-free menu language and request modifiers are not converted into absence guarantees or cross-contact claims.

findings.summary: The record is the sole Comet Ping Pong at 5037 Connecticut Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20008.
The current union contains 82 food and nonalcoholic products across the official dinner, pasta, dessert, brunch, and soft-drink menu plus the exact linked ordering catalog.
All four required searches are complete. No official product-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact statement was found; Toast allergy flags are request controls, not composition evidence.
Thirteen renamed duplicate presentations were consolidated and the absent Whale Cake was classified stale; new current menu and nonalcoholic products were added.

proposedChanges: Bind the record to the sole Chevy Chase DC location at 5037 Connecticut Avenue NW.
Replace the duplicate-heavy 78-row baseline projection with the 82-product current union of complete official and linked-vendor food/nonalcoholic surfaces.
Collapse renamed duplicates such as garlic knots, meatball sliders, risotto balls, salads, pasta, cookies, and spaghetti squash; remove stale Whale Cake.

Publish official allergen data as accurately unavailable except for conservative positive ingredient evidence; do not treat gluten-free options or generic request controls as absence or cross-contact guarantees.
